chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Shu'ayb ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who forgot to pronounce the iqamah for the salat (prayer) until he had finished; should he repeat his salat (prayer)? He said: He does not repeat it, and he should not return to doing the like of it.

key_terms.انْصَرَفَ: finished and departed from the prayer
key_terms.لِمِثْلِهَا: to the like of this act
key_terms.يُقِيمَ: to pronounce the iqamah for commencing the prayer

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets the iqamah until after finishing salat (prayer), must the prayer be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the iqamah before performing salat (prayer) and only remembers after finishing. The Imam عليه السلام states that the prayer is not to be repeated, while also instructing that such neglect should not be repeated in the future.
